about: The recorder's text font (NSFont.systemFont, semibold, as Captions.swift TextPlates.render draws it), measured on macOS 27.2 by scripts/recorder/text-metrics.swift; do not edit by hand. Widths and kerning are in 1/10000 em. advances has one row per font pixel size in sizes, one width per character of chars; between two sizes a width is interpolated, outside them the nearest size holds. fallback is the width of a character outside chars, per size. kerning adds to two neighbouring characters: left and right give each character's class, pairs[left class] lists right class, value at kerning.sizes[0], value at kerning.sizes[1]; between the two sizes it is interpolated. A line is round(ascender x px) + round(descender x px) + round(leading x px) pixels tall.
